The '''Thirty-Fourth Pius Crusade''' was a religious [[Pius Dea Crusades|crusade]] orchestrated by the [[Pius Dea]] cult and their leaders, the [[Contispex dynasty]]. The Pius Dea-controlled [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] launched an assault against [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], using the nearby [[Ord Dycoll]], [[Ord Wylan]], [[Ord Klina]], [[Ord Ortag]], and [[Ord Lonesome]] as staging points for their attacks on the southern end of the region.
